scope: Crosswalk newly reviewed LibreDWG parser-safety advisories to local AC1.40, R13-R2000 class, and text-codec boundaries; update the implementation plan without claiming a local vulnerability.

method.kind: Primary security-advisory pages plus read-only local source, test, and plan inspection
method.evidenceBoundary: The advisory vulnerability details and published reproducer descriptions are treated as upstream reports. Local applicability is assessed by static comparison only; no local vulnerability was reproduced or declared.

evidence.peerReport: CVE-2026-62250 reports a 496-byte pre-R13 AC1.40 input that leads LibreDWG decode_preR13_entities() to repeated allocations after the clamped end and separate loop size diverge; the advisory lists affected versions <=0.14 and no patched version.

observed: dwgReaderR1_40::readFileHeader rejects m_dwgSize below 0x202 or above physical file size instead of clamping the end.
The entity stream starts at 0x202, so the advisory's reported 496-byte specimen is shorter than the local entity-stream start.
Successful entity reads advance cursor to the consumed buffer position and each record begins with a 4-byte type/layer header.
Existing generated AC1.40 tests cover REPEAT refusal but not malformed dwg_size boundaries.
localStaticCrossCheck.inference: The reported 496-byte case should be rejected before entity iteration by the current local header guard; this was not executed.

evidence.planAction: Add source-authored in-memory boundary and truncation controls to the existing reader-matrix test; assert exact stage, no callbacks on invalid header, bounded failure, positive exact lower boundary, and same-reader recovery. Never copy or commit the advisory PoC.

evidence.topic: R13-R2000 class-count advisory is structurally distinct
evidence.peerReport: CVE-2026-62254 reports a num_classes-driven realloc-per-entry denial of service in LibreDWG decode_R13_R2000; affected versions are listed as before 0.14.

observed: The local reader validates the CLASSES section's physical range and declared byte size.
It parses staged class records until the byte cursor reaches the bounded class-data span rather than reallocating from a separate num_classes field.
It validates custom class IDs and duplicate IDs before publication.

evidence.planAction: Retain section-bound and per-record bit-cursor progress assertions when the local class parser is next changed; do not add a speculative peer-derived class-count cap or duplicate finding.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG const-input conversion advisory has no matched local defect
evidence.peerReport: The advisory identifies a const-input write/crash in LibreDWG's bit_TV_to_utf8() iconv error path.
evidence.localDisposition: This is a different implementation path from libdxfrw DRW_TextCodec; no matching local defect was established. Existing text-codec malformed-input work remains the owner.
